breakdown.description: The follower hole pressure is replaced by a dead load using the reference normal
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'A uniform follower pressure of 0.10 MPa is applied to the hole boundary' and 'The follower pressure is applied normal to the deformed hole surface.' This correctly implements the follower pressure using the current (deformed) configuration normal, rather than the dead load approach using the reference normal that was present in the incomplete prompt.
